title: HiTOP Manifestation Record
description: Canonical, nested record schema for HiTOP manifestation metadata. Matches the YAML structure documented in docs/modular-namespaced-suffix-schema.md (section 9) and validated at runtime by hitop.suffix.metadata.validate_metadata. It is intentionally not bound to a specific institution, study, module, instrument, or namespace authority.

code.description: Full HiTOP manifestation code in the form <HITOP_BASE_CODE>.M-<TT>-<NS>-<SLUG>.

hitop_base_code.description: Stable atomic HiTOP base code without a manifestation suffix.

suffix_block.description: Literal manifestation suffix block marker; always 'M'.

namespace.description: Local authority namespace this manifestation was minted under.

kind.description: Three-letter source kind (ROR, DOI, DNS, SRC, ORC, ARK, or HTP).

identifier.description: Canonical authority identifier used to derive the namespace token.

base_slug.description: Slug before optional disambiguation; required when slug is disambiguated.

disambiguator.description: Six-character disambiguator, present only for disambiguated slugs.

disambiguation_basis.description: Canonical basis string the disambiguator was derived from.

preferred_label.description: Preferred local label or source identifier for the manifestation.

definition.description: Human-readable definition of the manifestation as operationalized in its source context.

operationalization.description: Instrument, item, and scoring details for the manifestation.

scale_type.description: Scale type, for example Likert, ordinal, nominal, continuous, or binary.

value_range.description: Permitted value range or value set summary.

selection_type.description: Selection behavior, for example single choice or multiple choice.

data_type.description: Data type of the recorded response.

source.description: Provenance of the manifestation within its originating study or instrument. Requires item_id or local_concept_id, matching hitop.suffix.metadata.validate_metadata.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the record, for example active, deprecated, replaced, or draft.

replaced_by.description: Successor code(s), if this record is deprecated.

mapping_review_status.description: Review status of semantic mapping decisions, for example unreviewed, automatic, or curated.

mappings.description: Mapping relations to other manifestation codes.

relation.description: SKOS mapping relation, for example skos:exactMatch or skos:closeMatch.

mapping_artifact.description: Reference to the mapping specification or curated artifact this relation was decided under.

provenance.description: Who created and reviewed this record, and why.

extension_value.description: Controlled extension value for use-case-specific fields. Extension field names must start with x_.
